title: App Studio 改版（1-0b）：ADR-0084 修订补遗——补回裁决 3 的「整组判定」句、form 尚未注册、裁决改动清单、三处修订标记
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbL6Nn3scsU8yvLyU4

Filing gate: ③ · Source: contract record 7188270415 on PR #37470 (nits N2–N5) and the seat's L1 ACCEPT 7188379901, which accepted them as deviations to carry "into the next ADR touch or a docs card under #37424". Sub-issue of #37424 (phase 1, follow-up to P1-0 #37451).
Grade: area:ux · documentation · p2 (takes the parent's grade) · evidence: the record's nits, checked against their sources by the #37451 card thread.
Reader: area `ux-37424` (seat `repo:objectstack#5`); the #37451 card thread, which holds the fix as commit b0d9b548 (patch: `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat5/topic-37424/cards/card-37451/review-nits-N2-N5.patch`, ADR-0084 only, 9 lines, 21 gates exit 0, pin test 12/12).

Blocked-by: #37451 (PR #37470 in the merge queue at filing; the fix was not pushed there so the approver-queued head stays as reviewed).

## 维护者速读

- 改什么：#37470 合并后，对 ADR-0084 修订再补 9 行文字。最要紧的是补回裁决 3 漏写的一句：「移进软件包」按整组判定是否跨边界（ADR-0150 D3 (a)）。不补的话，第四阶段照 ADR 拆卡会漏掉这条安全相关规则。
- 其余三处：form 还没注册（原文写成已注册）；裁决改动清单补上决定 1；三处缺「Amended 2026-11-26」标记。
- 需要你做的：这是 ADR 改动，仍走 Tier H（os-zhuang、hotlong 审批），由你合并。

## What

All in `docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md`, Amendment (2026-11-26) section and the marks it owes:

- **N3 (first):** restore the dropped clause of ruling 3 (record 7184753035): the "move into package" door judges the selection as a set for ADR-0150 D3 (a)'s cross-boundary rule.
- **N4:** `form` is not yet registered (#37086 registers it); the text says "registered after".
- **N5:** add decision 1's line on ADR-0146's split to the list of epic decisions a ruling changed ("Decided by").
- **N2:** the three missing "Amended 2026-11-26" marks: the 2026-11-24 top note and the two repeats of the datasource / "one app" example.

Not in scope: N1 (item 11, `form` fifth in 常用; named to the maintainer at hand-off, no change owed), N6 (still true), N7 (ADR-0159 D10, carried on #37087 comment 7188492147).

## Acceptance

- The 9-line delta above, nothing else; `studioMenuPlacement.test.ts` stays 12/12 (no second table of the type→group row shape).
- Derived gates exit 0. Tier H hand-off to os-zhuang + hotlong; the maintainer merges.
